full_judgment: 14. Section 207 of the Penal Code is with regard to fraudulent or deceitful acceptance, receipt or claim of any property or any interest therein (by a person having no right or interest in it) with the purpose of preventing that property or interest from being taken as a forfeiture or in satisfaction of a fine, under a sentence which has been pronounced or is likely to be pronounced by a court of justice, or from being taken in execution of a decree or order made or to be made by a court of Justice in a civil suit. The facts described in the petition of complaint do not also bring the accused petitioner anywhere within the mischief of section 207 of the Penal Code.
